name: Wafer Works (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Wafer Works (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. operates as an integrated manufacturer of semiconductor silicon epitaxial wafers in China, North America, Europe, and other Asian countries. It offers semiconductor silicon epitaxial wafers, buried epitaxial wafers, polished section OEMs, and integrated epitaxial substrates used in the production of power devices and analog chips, as well as in the fields of automobiles, communications, electric power, industry, consumer electronics, and high-end equipment. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Second Smelters Factory 901. The company was founded in 1960 and is based in Shanghai, China.
